gloss: calling someone by name without an honorific

definitions.gloss: calling someone by name without an honorific
definitions.explanation: The practice of addressing someone by their name alone, without attaching an honorific suffix such as さん, くん, or ちゃん. This is considered casual or intimate, and can be rude when used with someone of higher status or someone you are not close to.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{捨|す}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧だ。
examples.english: It is rude to address a teacher without an honorific.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|した}しい→親しい：02345_shitashii⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{呼|よ}び{捨|す}て⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{呼|よ}び{合|あ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: We are close friends, so we call each other by name without honorifics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初対面|しょたいめん}→初対面：07306_shotaimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{捨|す}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{無礼|ぶれい}→無礼：15041_burei⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}なされる→見なす：10615_minasu⟧。
examples.english: Addressing someone you have just met without an honorific is considered extremely rude in Japan.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Typically used in the pattern {呼|よ}び{捨|す}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to address without honorifics) or {呼|よ}び{捨|す}て⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call by name alone).

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese social norms, using someone's name without an honorific implies closeness or equal/lower status. Using {呼|よ}び{捨|す}て with a superior, elder, or stranger is considered disrespectful. Between close friends or within families, it signals intimacy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呼|よ}び{捨|す}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to call without an honorific)
- {呼|よ}び{捨|す}て⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to address by name alone)
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{捨|す}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to call someone's name without a title)
